sourcePreservation: Original PNGs are unchanged. Crops retain source resolution and no enhancement is applied.
controlCoordinates: controlBounds and peopleBadgeBounds are [x,y,width,height] normalized to the tile image; badgeX and badgeY are normalized center coordinates; badgeSize is diameter divided by min(tile width,tile height). Baked source controls must be fully covered by an opaque actual interactive control.

assets.note: Own Jasmine camera photograph with its noninteractive face bracket depiction.

reconciliations.detail: The source depicts 14 photo rectangles while labelling 12 matched photos. Two partial bottom fragments are render variants: nearest city fragment uses logical photo 2 and cathedral fragment uses logical photo 5. This logical identity is a demo presentation assumption because the supplied source is partial; exact individual crop bytes and positions are retained.

Seven source photo rectangles represent six logical photos. Hero and upper-right hat portrait are two crops/variants of logical photo 1, as visually reconciled by the coordinating owner. Both obey the same selection state.
